title: Sync fails with 401 Unauthorized after updating to 3.2.0 (worked on 3.1.5)

text.body:
### Describe the bug
After updating to 3.2.0 every sync fails:

```
ERROR widget_core::sync: sync failed: HTTP 401 Unauthorized (token_audience_mismatch)
```

Logging out and in again works (login succeeds) but the next sync fails with the same error.

### Steps to reproduce
1. Be logged in on 3.1.5
2. Update to 3.2.0
3. Sync

### Expected behavior
Sync works like on 3.1.5

### Version
3.2.0

### OS
Windows 11, also seen on macOS 14 and Ubuntu 24.04 (see reactions)

### Additional context
Can't downgrade because 3.2.0 already migrated the library db.

title: sync: never replace non-empty remote content with a zero-length file

text.body:
Fixes #780
Fixes #801

When a client resumes after being offline, the planner compared mtimes before the local write had been flushed, so a truncated file with a newer mtime won and was pushed to every device.

This PR:
- refuses to upload a zero-length file over non-empty remote content unless the user explicitly emptied it (tracked via the editor's last-save event)
- keeps the previous remote version in history instead of overwriting it in place
- adds an integration test that simulates sleep/offline mid-write

Recovery for users who were already hit is being handled server-side, separately.

title: refactor(sync): split engine.rs into plan, apply and transport modules

text.body:
`crates/widget-core/src/sync/engine.rs` was 3,800 lines. This splits it into:

- `sync/plan.rs`: diffing and the `Planner`
- `sync/apply.rs`: applying remote changes locally
- `sync/transport.rs`: batching and retries

No behaviour change intended; all existing sync tests pass unchanged. The public API of `widget-core` re-exports the same names from `sync::`, except `engine::Planner`, which is now `plan::Planner`.

title: main doesn't build since #857

  --> crates/widget-cli/src/cmd/push.rs:7:5

7  | use crate::sync::engine::Planner;

error: could not compile `widget-cli` (bin "widget") due to 1 previous error

title: Scanner reports a CVE in the bundled zip library (confirmed false positive)

text.body:

I went through it with our security team: widget only uses the in-memory reader, never the streaming extract API, and the vulnerable code isn't reachable. So we confirmed it's a false positive for widget.

Still, could you either bump the library in the next release or add a note to SECURITY.md about it? Our scanner will keep flagging it and every customer will ask.
